hook: Cholera in Africa tracks El Nino in five regional patterns, with a projected surge in the east.
summary: Using 15 years of surveillance data from 30 countries, the authors grouped African countries into five zones where El Nino changes the timing, size, or length of cholera outbreaks. For the 2026-27 El Nino they project two to five times more cholera in Eastern Africa and the Horn than in neutral years. The projection depends on statistical and simulation models fitted to surveillance data, which may be uneven in quality across countries.
title: El Nino Southern Oscillation shapes cholera in Africa
